system_prompt_style.note: Mobile-Agent-v2 source files not in the evidence bundle. The paper does not describe how the system prompt is built.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Inputting a screenshot into this module will ultimately yield the text and icon information present on the screen, along with their respective coordinates.
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value. The visual perception module (OCR, icon detection) injects a screen-element summary each step; no repository context is involved.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The planning agent condenses lengthy, interleaved image-text history operations and screens summaries into a pure-text task progress

observation_format.evidence_quote: Inputting a screenshot into this module will ultimately yield the text and icon information present on the screen, along with their respective coordinates.
observation_format.note: The screenshot image is given to the decision agent (S_t) together with the perception text (P_t), per Eq. 3.

tool_call_format.note: No parser code for v2 is in the bundle.

tool_count.note: The paper lists 6 operations (Open app, Tap, Swipe, Type, Home, Stop), but no tool schema was available to count.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: we design an operation space and restricted the decision agent to selecting operations only from within this space.
edit_primitive.note: The operation space is a GUI action set with no file-editing primitive.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: To reduce the complexity of operations, we design an operation space

protocol_standardization.note: v2 source code or dependency files not in the bundle.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The operation of Mobile-Agent-v2 is iterative
loop_primitives.note: generate_test_repair covers the reflection agent, which judges each operation and triggers re-execution.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the planning agent observes the decision agent’s operation Ot−1 from the last iteration and updates the task progress T Pt−1 to T Pt.
planning_granularity.note: The task progress text is carried and updated across steps.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The architecture comprises three agents: planning agent, decision agent, and reflection agent.
multi_agent_topology.note: Fixed per-iteration sequence: planning, then decision, then reflection.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: After generating the task progress, the planning agent passes it to the decision agent.

human_in_loop.note: No run loop code available. Knowledge injection is manual hint input, not gating.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: we design a memory unit to store the focus content related to the current task from history screens.
short_term_state.note: State also includes the task progress and the operation history.

long_term_memory.note: Paper only. The memory unit is described as short-term; no code was available to check cross-run persistence.

state_persistence.note: No v2 code in the bundle.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we design the reflection agent to observe the screen state before and after a decision agent’s operation to determine whether the current operation meets expectations.
self_verification.note: The reflection agent is a separate role, but it uses the same GPT-4V model, so this could also be read as self_critique.

rollback.evidence_quote: If erroneous operation, the page will revert to the state before the operation.
rollback.note: Closest value. The revert mechanism is unspecified; it is likely GUI back-navigation. Flagged as an ambiguity.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: If the decision agent thinks that all requirements have been fulfilled, it can use this operation to terminate the entire operation process.
termination_condition.note: Other caps are not reported because no code was available.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: We used Android Debug Bridge (ADB) as the tool for operating mobile devices.
execution_isolation.note: Closest value. Actions run on a real external device over ADB.

eval_hooks.note: The bundle shows an AndroidWorld runner, but only for Mobile-Agent-v3; the v2 directory was not included.

target_domain.evidence_quote: we propose Mobile-Agent-v2, a multi-agent architecture for mobile device operation assistance.

open_source.note: The paper says the code is open-sourced, but no LICENSE file is in the bundle.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we evaluate the performance of different MLLMs within the Mobile-Agent-v2 framework.
model_agnostic.note: Tested with GPT-4V, Gemini-1.5-Pro and Qwen-VL-Max. The client abstraction was not seen.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/X-PLUG/MobileAgent.
primary_artifact.note: The v2 subdirectory code is not in the bundle, so coding is paper-based. The monorepo main branch has moved on to v3/v3.5.

first_release_date.note: Basis is the paper v1 date; no tag information was available.

pinned_version.note: No tag is available and the full hash is not given. This is a monorepo containing v2 as a subdirectory.

stars.note: Date of the star count is not stamped in the evidence.
